```{python}
#| label: fig-scatter-density
#| fig-alt: "Scatter points layered over a density surface"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import soundscapy as sspy

data = sspy.isd.load_demo()

sspy.iso_plot(
    data,
    title="Scatter and density",
    plot_layers=["scatter", "density"],
    diagonal_lines=True,
)
plt.show()
```
